# Retribution Paladin — Raid (group)

[Paladin](../README.md) > [Raid (group)](README.md) > Retribution

**✅ Recommended** for raid (the best paladin spec here, or within 3% of it).

**[Retribution — Seal of Command / Twist of Light](../research/raid/builds/ret-full-buffs-raid.md)** (10/8/33) — [open the talent tree](https://talentsforever.com/paladin/60/52003-503-05225231001330321-4)

## How to play

**Before the pull:** **Seal of Command**.

**Keep up all fight:** **Seal of Command**, **Seal of Righteousness**.

**Then press the first one that is ready**, top to bottom:

1. **Hammer of Wrath** when the target is below 20% health
2. **Consecration**
3. **Holy Strike**

**Holy Strike** is your filler: cast it whenever nothing above is ready.

*The simulator's full rotation for this build, with every condition: [research rotation page](../research/raid/rotation.md).*
